proposed_changes.summary: Weekly automated container base-image rebuild patching OS library CVEs and scheduled 90-day mTLS leaf certificate rotation under existing CMVP-4798 module.
Add in-boundary read-only tool 'agency_rubric_scorer' hosted inside the existing Isolation Runtime behind existing Authorization PEP and Tool Registry allowlist; zero new TPIRs or egress routes.
Onboard an external third-party SaaS document-OCR MCP server outside the CSO MAS to parse uploaded grant PDFs containing Federal Customer Data.
